name: Queued Up
tagline: The Free Weekly MusicScene Guitarist & Theory Digest
subjectLine: [Queued Up #1] 5 New Masterclasses: Beatles, Oasis, Hendrix, Muse & Hoodoo Gurus + Tone Dials
previewText: Unlock the line cliché, secondary dominants, and harmonic minor arpeggios in our newest song analyses.
welcomeMessage: Welcome to the inaugural edition of Queued Up! Every week, we break down newly added song masterclasses, dissect harmonic secrets that make legendary riffs tick, and share actionable practice drills you can take straight to your fretboard.

newSongs.title: While My Guitar Gently Weeps
newSongs.theoryTakeaway: Descending chromatic line cliché (A -> G -> F# -> F) combined with an uplifting parallel A Major bridge modulation.

newSongs.title: Don't Look Back in Anger
newSongs.theoryTakeaway: Secondary dominant E7 (V of vi) leading into F, followed by a bittersweet borrowed minor iv (Fm) in the pre-chorus.

newSongs.title: What's My Scene
newSongs.theoryTakeaway: Jangly high-string double stops over open E pedal drones with an ascending scalar chord walkup (F#m -> G#m -> A -> B) into the solo.

newSongs.title: The Wind Cries Mary
newSongs.theoryTakeaway: Parallel chromatic sliding triads (Eb -> E -> F) and Curtis Mayfield-inspired thumb-over chord embellishments.

newSongs.title: Plug In Baby
newSongs.theoryTakeaway: Neoclassical arpeggio loops starting on the dominant F# major, showcasing the exotic A# leading tone from B Harmonic Minor.

theorySecretOfTheWeek.title: Why Borrowing Minor iv (Fm in C Major) Breaks Hearts Every Single Time
theorySecretOfTheWeek.explanation: In standard C major diatonic harmony, the IV chord is F major (notes: F - A - C). But when Noel Gallagher shifts from F to Fm in 'Don't Look Back in Anger', he lowers the 3rd by a half step: A becomes Ab. That Ab note is borrowed directly from C Aeolian (natural minor). When an upbeat major key progression suddenly introduces the minor 6th degree, it triggers an instant sensation of longing and vulnerability before resolving safely home.

gearPresetOfTheWeek.targetTone: Eric Clapton ('Lucy' Les Paul) & Noel Gallagher (Marshall JCM)
gearPresetOfTheWeek.tip: Instead of turning down amp gain, keep the preamp at 6.5 and roll your guitar volume knob down to 7.0 for verse picking, then crank it to 10 for screaming lead solos.

practiceChallengeOfTheWeek.name: The 5-Minute Line Cliché Endurance Drill
instructions: Fret a standard open A minor chord with fingers 1 and 2 anchored on fret 1 (B string) and fret 2 (D string).
Cycle the bass notes on beats 1 and 3: open A -> 3rd fret low E (G) -> 2nd fret low E (F#) -> 1st fret low E (F).
Focus on never muting the high open E string with your fret-hand palm.
Do 5 uninterrupted minutes at 50 BPM before moving up to 66 BPM.
